brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully completed all seven responsibility-chain items with evidence spanning wound assessment, medication verification, fall prevention, and closure confirmation. One high-order point (HO2) was completed by actively repairing the execution failure, transitioning from blocked community care to a concrete emergency department plan with clear timing and fallbacks. Two other high-order points (HO1, HO4) were partially completed with meaningful trajectory impact. No in-chain errors were present. Closure was valid with safe, executable, and traceable handoff to emergency and orthopedic services.
